title: (b) Version Alignment Plan — v0.28.x → v1.0.0
markdown:
# (b) Version Alignment Plan — v0.28.x → v1.0.0

**Status:** Planning only. No PRs cut. Gated on lockdown spec layers 1, 2, and 6 merging first.
**Date drafted:** 2026-05-19
**Companion docs:** Incident case study, Deployment Lockdown spec

---

## What this is

The mechanical sequence of commits, version moves, and communication artifacts required to align the published npm version with the v1.0.0 narrative — under option (b) ("v1.0.0 has effectively shipped, just mis-versioned").

This plan does NOT execute until:
- Lockdown spec Layer 1 (package.json as version-truth) is merged
- Lockdown spec Layer 2 (`release-tier.json` with initial `"hold"`) is merged
- Lockdown spec Layer 6 (coherence refusal) is merged

Until those land, the publish workflow will still patch-bump and re-publish whatever I do. Order matters.

---

## The cut sequence

### Step 1 — Hold (already needed for lockdown anyway)
Set `.instar/release-tier.json` to `"hold"`. This pauses all auto-publish. No-op once Layer 2 lands; explicit until then via temporarily emptying `upgrades/NEXT.md` between PRs.

### Step 2 — Align package.json forward
On a dedicated PR titled "chore(release): align package.json to v1.0.0":
- `package.json`: `"version": "1.0.0"` (matches the narrative).
- `package-lock.json`: same.
- No code changes.
- NEXT.md frontmatter: `hold: true` (so even if Layer 2 hasn't landed, the workflow skips).

This PR merges to main but does not publish. Verified by: `npm view instar version` returns `0.28.125` post-merge.

### Step 3 — Write the alignment guide
On a follow-up PR, add `upgrades/v1.0.0-alignment.md` with the user-visible release note:

> "Instar v1.0.0 is now stamped at v1.0.0 on npm. The v1.0.0 framework-functional-parity code has been shipping under v0.28.122–v0.28.125 patches since 2026-05-19; this version-number jump acknowledges the milestone explicitly. Behavior on this v1.0.0 release matches v0.28.125 — there are no new features beyond what was already on npm."

The PR also moves NEXT.md content (if any) into this guide. NEXT.md frontmatter stays `hold: true` until the cut.

### Step 4 — Cut v1.0.0
Once steps 1–3 are merged and verified:
- Update `release-tier.json` to `"major"` (multi-signature, per Layer 5 of the lockdown spec).
- Two signatures land in `.instar/release-signatures/v1.0.0.sig`.
- Remove `hold: true` from NEXT.md frontmatter (or move the guide into a finalized NEXT.md).
- The publish workflow honors the major tier, verifies signatures, reads package.json (= 1.0.0), refuses any coherence mismatch, and publishes `instar@1.0.0` to npm.
- Release tag `v1.0.0` is created.

### Step 5 — Return to patch tier
Post-cut, `release-tier.json` is moved back to `"patch"`. Subsequent maintenance releases (v1.0.1, v1.0.2, …) ship through the normal patch flow.

---

## Communication artifacts

In addition to the alignment guide (step 3), Echo posts to topic 10873 at each step:

- Step 1 hold engaged: short confirmation
- Step 2 package.json bumped: confirmation + verification that npm version is unchanged
- Step 3 alignment guide written: link to private view
- Step 4 cut complete: short confirmation + `npm view instar version` output
- Step 5 patch tier restored: short confirmation

Each post is also relayed to topic 9984 with a one-line "step N complete" pointer for visibility.

---

## What we do NOT do

- **No retroactive unpublish or deprecation of v0.28.122–v0.28.125.** The audit determined that creates more confusion than it solves. Those versions remain on npm with their existing upgrade-guide content describing v1.0.0 framework parity.
- **No "v0.29.0 transitional" release.** Going straight from v0.28.x to v1.0.0 is cleaner and matches the narrative authors used internally for weeks.
- **No code changes in the alignment cut itself.** The alignment PR is purely metadata + the alignment guide. Code work resumes on patch tier afterward.

---

## Order summary

| Phase | Status | Gating |
|-------|--------|--------|
| Lockdown spec layers 1, 2, 6 merged | Pending operator approval | Justin's go on the lockdown spec |
| Step 1 — Hold engaged | After Layer 2 merge | Layer 2 |
| Step 2 — package.json forward | After Step 1 | None |
| Step 3 — Alignment guide | After Step 2 | None |
| Step 4 — Cut v1.0.0 | After Step 3 | Layer 5 multi-signature (Justin + one other) |
| Step 5 — Patch tier restored | After Step 4 | None |

---

## Awaiting

Operator approval on the lockdown spec before any of this executes.
